description: The comparison was rearranged without changing its meaning.
before:
def can_withdraw(balance, amount):
    return amount <= balance
after:
def can_withdraw(balance, amount):
    return balance >= amount

description: A total calculation was changed from addition to subtraction.
A correct guard rejects non-positive amounts.
before:
def withdraw(balance, amount):
    return balance - amount

description: The average divisor was changed incorrectly.
A local variable was renamed consistently, without changing behavior.
The changed index skips the first element and fails for a one-item list.
The changed async call returns a coroutine instead of the user object.
before:
async def fetch_name(client, user_id):
    user = await client.get_user(user_id)
    return user.name
after:
async def fetch_name(client, user_id):
    user = client.get_user(user_id)
    return user.name

description: The private helper no longer checks a condition already enforced by its only caller; this case checks use of surrounding context.
A pre-existing divide-by-zero possibility is near the diff but not introduced by the changed line.
